chemistry-killer-01.title: Ilaalinta miisaanka, saamiga joogtada ah, kulayl soo saarid iyo kulayl nuugid
chemistry-killer-01.topic: Ilaalinta miisaanka, saamiga joogtada ah, kulayl soo saarid iyo kulayl nuugid
chemistry-killer-01.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
chemistry-killer-01.material:
Budada copper (Cu) ayaa lagu falgalay oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) weel xidhan si loo sameeyo copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Tijaabo kasta, $\mathrm{O_2}$ ee weelka ku jira waa 2.0 g, falgalkuna waa $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Cufka CuO ee la sameeyay kadib falgalka waa sidan:
(I) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(II) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(III) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Xaaladaha isku midka ah marka sharciga saamiga joogtada ah run yahay, haddii Cu 14.0 g iyo $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g weelka isku mid ah lagu falgaliyo ilaa mid ka mid ah walxaha falgala dhammaado, waa kuwee natiijo sax ah?
chemistry-killer-01.thinking.0: Ilaalinta miisaanka, saamiga joogtada ah, kulayl soo saarid iyo kulayl nuugid
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.prompt:
Budada copper (Cu) ayaa lagu falgalay oxygen ($\mathrm{O_2}$) weel xidhan si loo sameeyo copper(II) oxide ($\mathrm{CuO}$). Tijaabo kasta, $\mathrm{O_2}$ ee weelka ku jira waa 2.0 g, falgalkuna waa $\mathrm{2Cu + O_2 \rightarrow 2CuO}$. Cufka CuO ee la sameeyay kadib falgalka waa sidan:
(I) Cu 4.0 g → CuO 5.0 g
(II) Cu 8.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
(III) Cu 12.0 g → CuO 10.0 g
Xaaladaha isku midka ah marka sharciga saamiga joogtada ah run yahay, haddii Cu 14.0 g iyo $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g weelka isku mid ah lagu falgaliyo ilaa mid ka mid ah walxaha falgala dhammaado, waa kuwee natiijo sax ah?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.explain:
Tallaabo 1: Xaaladda (III), halkaas oo CuO uusan ka badnaan 10.0 g xitaa marka Cu la kordhiyo, waa xaalad dhammaan $\mathrm{O_2}$ 2.0 g oo weelka ku jirtay ay falgashay, sidaa darteed CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g, taasoo ah Cu:O = 4:1 (hubin: (I) waa Cu 4.0 g + O 1.0 g = 5.0 g oo O hadhay, (II) waa Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g = 10.0 g oo aan dhimmin ama hadhin, (III) Cu 4.0 g ayaa hadhay).
Tallaabo 2: Cufka O ee si buuxda ula falgalaya Cu 14.0 g = $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g. Maadaama $\mathrm{O_2}$ 4.0 g oo la bixiyay ay ka badan tahay, Cu dhammaantiis way falgashaa $\mathrm{O_2}$ $4.0-3.5=0.5$ g ayaa hadhaya.
Tallaabo 3: CuO la sameeyay = 14.0 + 3.5 = 17.5 g (ilaalinta cuf, saamiga walxaha Cu:O:CuO = 4:1:5).
Sidaas darteed jawaabta saxda ah waa a: $\mathrm{O_2}$.
(Jawaabaha khaldan: wadarta cufka 18.0 g waxay ku jirtaa O aan falgalin, 20.0 g waxaa lagu xisaabiyay O 4.0 g iyadoo la iska indho tiray yaraanta Cu.)
chemistry-killer-01.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-01.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.hint.0: Xaaladda (III) ee Cu hadhayo, 10.0 g oo CuO ah waxay ka kooban tahay dhammaan 2.0 g oo O ah ee weelka ku jira → hel saamiga cufka Cu:O, kadibna isbarbar dhig si aad u ogaato midka yar. Cufka walxaha la sameeyay = Cu falgalay + O falgalay.
chemistry-killer-01.s.s1.hint.1: (III): CuO 10.0 g = Cu 8.0 g + O 2.0 g → saamiga cufka Cu:O = 4:1. O ee la falgala Cu 14.0 g waa $14.0 \times \frac{1}{4} = 3.5$ g < 4.0 g, sidaa darteed Cu waa walxaha xaddidaya falgalka.
